tagline: Leading global structural heart innovation company improving patient lives
hero_kpi_rationale: TAVR segment revenue is a key driver of the company's growth, representing 74% of total sales with a 9.3% increase in 2025 to $4,487.7 million.

kpis.name: TAVR Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from transcatheter aortic valve replacement products
kpis.description: TAVR revenue represents the majority of the company's sales and is the primary growth driver
kpis.signal: Growth in the TAVR products market

kpis.name: TMTT Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from transcatheter mitral and tricuspid therapies products
kpis.description: TMTT revenue increased by 56.4% in 2025, primarily driven by sales of the PASCAL and EVOQUE systems
kpis.signal: Very strong growth in the TMTT segment

kpis.name: Surgical Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from structural heart surgical products
kpis.description: Surgical revenue growth is primarily driven by sales of the INSPIRIS RESILIA and MITRIS RESILIA valves
kpis.signal: Moderate growth in the surgical segment

kpis.name: Total Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Total consolidated net sales of the company
kpis.description: Total net sales increased by $628.1 million in 2025, driven by growth in TAVR and TMTT

kpis.name: R&D Intensity
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses as a percentage of net sales
kpis.description: The company invests 18% of its sales in R&D, confirming its commitment to product innovation
kpis.signal: Significant investment in R&D to sustain innovation

risks.title: Innovation
risks.score_rationale: The company emphasizes the importance of innovation for its success, and a lack of innovation could render its products obsolete. This is mentioned multiple times in the report, particularly in the Business and Operating Risks section.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in highly competitive markets and faces aggressive competitors. This is mentioned in the Business and Operating Risks section.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company is vulnerable to cybersecurity attacks, which could significantly impact its operations and reputation. This is mentioned in the Business and Operating Risks section.

risks.title: Supplier Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on suppliers for the design, manufacturing, and sterilization of its products. This is mentioned in the Business and Operating Risks section.

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations, particularly regarding product safety and quality. This is mentioned in the Legal, Compliance and Regulatory Risks section.

risks.title: Pandemics and Epidemics
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to risks from pandemics and epidemics, which could significantly impact its operations and reputation. This is mentioned in the Business and Operating Risks section.

risks.title: Talent Recruitment and Retention
risks.score_rationale: The company needs to recruit and retain qualified employees to maintain its competitiveness. This is mentioned in the Business and Operating Risks section.

risks.title: Acquisition Integration
risks.score_rationale: The company has made acquisitions and must successfully integrate them to maintain competitiveness. This is mentioned in the Business and Operating Risks section.

ai_positioning.summary: The company EW does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.
